name: FH-mlcc
title: General series multilayer ceramic chip capacitors, 1005 (01005) to 1812, up to 50 V

source.document: General Type MLCC product specification, 1005~1812 type

summary: A family of general-purpose monolithic multilayer ceramic chip capacitors with nickel-barrier, tin-plated terminations, in nine sizes from 1005 (EIA 01005, 0.4 × 0.2 mm) to 1812 (4.5 × 3.2 mm). The class I C0G dielectric covers 0.1 pF to 100 nF; the class II dielectrics X7R, X7S, X7T, X6S, X6T and X5R cover 100 pF to 100 µF, at rated voltages of 6.3 V to 50 V. Every size, capacitance and voltage combination is assigned a thickness code. The parts suit reflow and, in the mid sizes, wave soldering, and are aimed at general consumer equipment.

operation.text: Class I covers C0G and C0H: their capacitance stays almost fixed over temperature, voltage and time, and they serve low-loss, high-stability and high-frequency circuits. Class II covers X7R, X7S, X7T, X6S, X6T and X5R: a higher dielectric constant gives higher capacitance than class I, with a semi-stable temperature characteristic; uses include DC blocking, coupling, bypass and frequency discrimination.
Filtering, coupling, resonant, bypass and high-frequency circuits. Suited to reflow and wave soldering.

Class II capacitance drifts with age; before capacitance is measured the parts are baked at 150℃ for 1 hour and left 24 hours, then measured at 25℃±3℃ and under 70%RH. Parts stored a long time get this heat treatment before their capacitance is checked.

A higher-voltage part of the same size, capacitance and dielectric covers the lower-voltage one. At the same size, capacitance and voltage an X7R part covers X7S, X7T, X6S and X5R (0402B104K250NT covers 0402BS104K250NT, 0402BT104K250NT, 0402DS104K250NT and 0402X104K250NT); those covered codes are not listed separately.

Soldering follows the reflow, wave or hand profile, since a sudden temperature change can crack the chip. During preheat, solder temperature and chip surface temperature differ by no more than 150℃. Uneven local heating from an iron can crack the ceramic, worst when the tip touches the body, so tip size and temperature need care. With an iron the solder fillet reaches at most half the chip thickness.
Do not reuse a capacitor taken off a board. Check rated capacitance and voltage, the capacitance at the applied voltage, and the mechanical stress in use. Check solderability of long-stored parts.

Use soon after delivery: heat, humidity and long storage can degrade the packing and oxidise the terminations. Keep the parts away from corrosive gases (hydrogen sulfide, sulfur dioxide, chlorine, ammonia), direct sunlight and high humidity.

Intended for general consumer equipment: home appliances, office, information, communication and AV equipment, phones and PCs. Not recommended for aerospace, medical, aviation, nuclear, disaster or crime prevention, heating and combustion, public information network and data processing, military, power generation control, safety, vehicle, traffic signal, transport or undersea equipment unless Fenghua has agreed in writing.
